plugins.name: principal
plugins.description: Staff-engineer and technical architect toolkit — 17 skills covering HLD, LLD, ADR, RFC, tech debt, scalability, databases (relational/MySQL/NoSQL/time-series/vector), LLM system design, incident response, migration (including Kafka event schema), API design, threat modeling, performance auditing with JVM profiling and distributed tracing, platform engineering (IDP/Backstage/golden paths), cloud design (FinOps/managed vs self-hosted), frontend review (Core Web Vitals/React/Next.js/bundle audit/accessibility), and production debugging (distributed/memory/crash/flaky). Fifteen commands and nine custom scripts: api-diff, dead-code, bus-factor, dep-audit, otel-check, schema-registry-diff, secret-scan (gitleaks integration), migration-safety (zero-downtime SQL DDL analysis), env-drift (env var documentation audit). Languages: TypeScript, Python (FastAPI/SQLAlchemy), Node.js, Java.
